map.Marketing terms explained in plain Engli: Marketing terms explained in plain English.
map.Short, simple meanings for the words you: Short, simple meanings for the words you will hear when you work with a marketing team.
map.The work of helping your website appear: The work of helping your website appear higher in search results such as Google, so more people find you without paying for ads.
map.Writing and organising your content so s: Writing and organising your content so search tools can pick it as the direct answer to a question, for example in a featured snippet or a voice assistant reply.
map.Making your business easy for AI assista: Making your business easy for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity to find, understand and mention when people ask them questions.
map.A word or phrase people type into a sear: A word or phrase people type into a search box, such as "dent repair near me".
map.When a search engine adds your page to i: When a search engine adds your page to its list of pages it can show. A page that is not indexed cannot appear in search results.
map.Visitors who find your website through u: Visitors who find your website through unpaid search results.
map.Hidden labels in a web page that tell se: Hidden labels in a web page that tell search engines and AI tools what the page is about, such as a business address or a list of questions and answers.
map.One time your page or ad is shown to som: One time your page or ad is shown to someone.
map.The share of people who clicked after se: The share of people who clicked after seeing your page or ad. If 100 people see it and 3 click, the click-through rate is 3%.
map.Where your page typically appears in sea: Where your page typically appears in search results. Position 1 is the top, and positions 11 to 20 are usually on the second page.
map.A valuable action a visitor takes, such: A valuable action a visitor takes, such as sending a form, calling you or booking a meeting.
map.The share of visitors who convert. If 20: The share of visitors who convert. If 200 people visit and 10 send a form, the conversion rate is 5%.
map.What you pay each time someone clicks yo: What you pay each time someone clicks your ad.
map.Your total ad spend divided by the numbe: Your total ad spend divided by the number of conversions. It tells you what each enquiry or sale costs you.
map.The page a person arrives on after click: The page a person arrives on after clicking an ad or link, built to get them to take one action.
map.The steps a person goes through from fir: The steps a person goes through from first seeing your business to becoming a customer.
map.Paid advertising that is measured by res: Paid advertising that is measured by results, such as leads or sales, instead of views.
map.Software that keeps your customers, enqu: Software that keeps your customers, enquiries and follow-ups in one place so nothing is forgotten.
map.Setting software to do routine tasks for: Setting software to do routine tasks for you, such as sending a reply or reminding you to follow up.
map.A program that answers questions in ever: A program that answers questions in everyday language, on a website, in WhatsApp or on the phone.
map.Work done by one company and delivered u: Work done by one company and delivered under another company's brand name.
